name: Taqueria El Tio
tagline: Late-night tacos on North Bryan Avenue, open until 2 AM every day.
about: Taqueria El Tio is a no-frills, hole-in-the-wall taqueria on North Bryan Avenue, and a stop on the Bryan Taco Trail.
Destination Bryan rates its tortas, al pastor and fajita tacos among the most authentic in town.
